title: Partner Payments Lead
description:
We’re seeking an experienced partner payments operator to manage monthly partner payments for one of our clients, a global tech and media company, supporting its streaming TV business. This is a contract role working with the client’s team.

As an independent vendor, you’ll set the rhythm and own the details. The role suits someone who enjoys making sense of complex agreements, tracking down why numbers don’t match, and building systems that make each month easier than the last.

What you’ll own

•
The monthly close: Calculate what each partner is owed, validate the results, and deliver payment files on time every cycle.

•
Contract-to-calculation logic: Read partner agreements and build the models and rules that turn their terms into accurate payouts.

•
Issue resolution: When something is off, find the source and fix it so it doesn’t come back.

•
Process improvement: Replace manual, error-prone steps with automated workflows.

•
Documentation: Maintain a clear playbook so the process is transparent, auditable, and easy to transfer.

•
Cross-team inputs: Work directly with finance, partnerships, and legal to get what you need.

What success looks like

• Payments go out accurately and on schedule, month after month

• Each discrepancy is logged with its cause and fix

• The playbook stays current and someone new could follow it

• Manual effort drops measurably over the course of the engagement

How you’ll work

You’ll run the process on your own and check in regularly with the business lead to review progress and resolve open questions (cadence to be agreed). You’ll bring in the client only for decisions that require its approval, such as releasing payments or interpreting ambiguous contract language.

Who we’re looking for

Minimum qualifications

• Background in partner payments, revenue share, royalty operations, deal desk, or finance operations

• Ability to read commercial contracts closely and translate their terms into financial logic

• Advanced SQL and spreadsheet skills

• Strong attention to detail and comfort working within financial controls

• Ability to communicate and influence cross-functionally at all levels of management

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in media or streaming, ideally at a large tech or media company

• Hands-on experience automating workflows or rolling out new tools, including managing the change

• Experience with partner audits or financial reconciliation

• Experience working directly with external partners

• Ability to prioritize and adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Salary: $68 - $75 / hour Originally posted on Himalayas
